d:
Challenge your core, balance, and full body control with an advanced flow that exposes exactly where stability starts to break down. Strong holds, rotational movement, single-leg balance, and arm balances demand focus from your entire body while giving you room to explore what you are capable of.
Real control becomes obvious when the movement gets difficult. Stay connected to your center, steady your breath under pressure, and finish feeling stronger, sharper, and more grounded.
